title: Call to Art Bell show and emails with an author who couldn't corroborate his account
place_text: Coast to Coast AM radio / email

tellings.quote: he couldn't include me any further books because he couldn't collaborate it,

plain: Richard Barth, a former guard at a nuclear missile site who says he was abducted by aliens, says he once called in to Coast to Coast AM, a late-night American radio show about the paranormal hosted by Art Bell, and later traded emails with an author about his experience. He tells Michels the author dropped him: "he couldn't include me any further books because he couldn't collaborate it," meaning the author could not find anything to back up Barth's account. Barth tells it himself, as part of how he tried and failed to get his story taken up.
